nodes.summary: An affine subspace $A$ of $\mathbb{R}^d$ is an affine hyperplane when there are a nonzero linear functional $\ell \colon \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}$ and a real number $c$ such that $A = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^d : \ell(x) = c\}$.
nodes.title: Affine hyperplanes in $\mathbb{R}^d$

nodes.summary: For every $d \ge 1$ and every set $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ whose affine span is all of $\mathbb{R}^d$, let $\mathcal{H}$ be the set of affine hyperplanes of $\mathbb{R}^d$ that equal the affine span of some subset of $P$. Then there is an injective map $f \colon P \to \mathcal{H}$ with $p \in f(p)$ for every $p \in P$.
nodes.title: Spanning point sets have injective point-to-hyperplane matchings

nodes.summary: The statement that for every $d \ge 1$ and every set $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ whose affine span is all of $\mathbb{R}^d$, writing $\mathcal{H}$ for the set of affine hyperplanes of $\mathbb{R}^d$ that equal the affine span of some subset of $P$, there is an injective map $f \colon P \to \mathcal{H}$ with $p \in f(p)$ for every $p \in P$.
nodes.title: Injective point-to-hyperplane matching question

nodes.summary: For a set $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$, the hyperplanes spanned by $P$ are the affine hyperplanes of $\mathbb{R}^d$ that equal the affine span of some subset of $P$.
nodes.title: Hyperplanes spanned by a point set

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
